description: This file contains unit tests for the Tenant class in the Eclipse Hono project, testing serialization/deserialization, validation, and configuration of tenant properties.

classes.name: TenantTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behavior of the Tenant class, including encoding, decoding, validation, and configuration handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a self-signed X.509 certificate for use in tests.

methods.name: testDecodeDefault
methods.description: Tests decoding of a Tenant object with default values.

methods.name: testDecodeDisabled
methods.description: Tests decoding of a Tenant with 'enabled=false'.

methods.name: testDecodeEnabled
methods.description: Tests decoding of a Tenant with 'enabled=true'.

methods.name: testDecodeExt
methods.description: Tests decoding of the 'ext' section in Tenant JSON.

methods.name: testDecodeAdapters
methods.description: Tests decoding of the 'adapters' section with valid adapter entries.

methods.name: testDecodeEmptyAdaptersListFails
methods.description: Ensures decoding fails when adapters list is empty.

methods.name: testWithMultipleAdapterEntriesOfSameType
methods.description: Ensures decoding fails when multiple adapters of the same type are present.

methods.name: testAddAdapterOfAlreadyExistingType
methods.description: Tests that adding an adapter of an existing type throws an exception.

methods.name: testDecodeMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Tests decoding of 'minimum-message-size' property.

methods.name: testDecodeWithoutMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Tests decoding when 'minimum-message-size' is absent, expecting default.

methods.name: testDecodeResourceLimits
methods.description: Verifies decoding of resource-limits section.

methods.name: testEncodeResourceLimitsDoesNotIncludeDefaultValues
methods.description: Verifies encoding omits default values in resource-limits.

methods.name: testDecodeTrustedCAUsingCert
methods.description: Tests decoding of trusted CA certificates from X.509 certificate payload.

methods.name: testDecodeTraceSampling
methods.description: Tests decoding of tracing configuration with sampling modes.

methods.name: testEncodeDefault
methods.description: Verifies encoding of a default Tenant results in empty JSON.

methods.name: testEncodeEnabled
methods.description: Tests encoding Tenant with 'enabled=true'.

methods.name: testEncodeDisabled
methods.description: Tests encoding Tenant with 'enabled=false'.

methods.name: testEncodeMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Verifies encoding of 'minimum-message-size'.

methods.name: testEncodeTraceSamplingModePerAuthId
methods.description: Verifies encoding of tracing configuration with sampling modes per authorization ID.

methods.name: testSerializeAdapters
methods.description: Ensures that Tenant with multiple adapters serializes correctly to JSON.
